newsitem.title: USA: Alleged Versace killer Cunanan dead - TV.
newsitem.headline: Alleged Versace killer Cunanan dead - TV.

text.p: A body has been found inside a houseboat besieged by Miami Beach police earlier on Wednesday and police believe it is that of Andrew Cunanan, the alleged killer of Italian fashion czar Gianni Versace, local television and radio said.
WINZ radio station said the individual appeared to have committed suicide and that a .40-calibre pistol like that allegedly used by Cunanan had been found inside. Police had no immediate comment.
